messages:
Olivia R: Hi all  just accepted the orientation invite but theres no meeting link in the mailer and my calendar shows 18:00 UTC which seemed odd. Can someone confirm the organizer timezone and paste the join link? Also where will the recording live?

Marta (People Ops): Welcome Olivia! :wave: Orientation is 11:00 PT (18:00 UTC). Zoom link is in the "Redwood Onboarding" calendar event; mailer copies sometimes strip it. Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/5678901234 (passcode: rwd-onboard). Recordings + auto-transcripts go to Drive: https://drive.reddemo.company/onboarding/ in a subfolder per session.

Onboarding Bot: Note: Events are authored in PT. Recordings will be uploaded within 24 hours and include autogenerated captions.

Olivia R: Thanks  could we get explicit times for PT/UTC/CEST/AEST in the event body? For international hires that would avoid confusion.

Jae (Calendar Ops): Good request  well update the template to include a small timezone table and the Drive placeholder link so recipients can see where the recording will appear before the meeting. If you see duplicate invites, open the one from the shared "Redwood Onboarding" calendar to reveal the details.

Luis V: FYI theres often a separate "REGIONS" office hours later the same day; recordings are saved in the same Drive folder with a REGIONS-<date> prefix. We try to add an agenda with timestamps after the call for folks catching up across time zones.

Olivia R: Perfect  Ill accept and watch the recording if timezone makes live attendance tricky. Appreciate the quick replies!

Marta (People Ops): Welcome again! Well post the Drive folder link in this thread after the session and add chapter timestamps if possible.
